description: This file defines a Perl module for a scheduled cron script that deletes expired sessions from a database. It uses Moose for object orientation and includes roles for debugging and schema handling. The main method 'run' performs the deletion based on a configurable number of days.

classes.name: Coocook::Script::Cron
classes.description: A Perl class representing a cron script for routine session cleanup tasks.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the session cleanup by deleting expired sessions based on the delta_days parameter.
